title:
Epic triggered on `Reliability.CreateMetricConfigurationAndPreviewPreviewFilterPanel.FILTER_SUBMIT` action to
to be able to change the current dates of the {@link ReliabilityMetric} that is being showed in the
`Reliability.CreateMetricConfigurationAndPreviewChart`.

The payload expected for this action is an object with the following properties:
- `dynamicComponentDataSourceId`: A string that contains the id that will be refreshed when the filter is applied.
name: MetricConfigApplyFilterToMetricPreviewEpic
